loadOrders: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.tenant_id, o.status, o.payment_status, o.total_amount, o.refund_amount, o.write_off_amount, o.paid_amount, o.pay_time, o.create_time, o.is_delivered, o.fulfillment_status, o.fulfillment_mode, o.collection_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_delivery_plan p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND p.tenant_id = o.tenant_id) AS plan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_delivery d WHERE d.order_id = o.id AND d.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND d.status = 2) AS delivery_done, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_financial_record f WHERE f.order_id = o.id AND f.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND f.record_type = 'MIGRATION_OPENING' AND f.deleted = 0) AS migration_openings FROM sale_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = ? AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.id
migrateOrder: UPDATE sale_order SET fulfillment_status = ?, fulfillment_mode = ?, collection_status = ?, settlement_method = ?, settled_at = ?, gross_received_amount = ?, net_received_amount = ?, balance_amount = ?, sales_return_amount = COALESCE(sales_return_amount, 0), cash_refund_amount = COALESCE(cash_refund_amount, 0) WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND deleted = 0
insertMigrationOpening: INSERT INTO order_financial_record (tenant_id, order_id, record_type, amount, occurred_at, reason, source, deleted) VALUES (?, ?, 'MIGRATION_OPENING', ?, ?, '历史实收期初（旧 paid_amount 快照）', 'MIGRATION', 0)
insertTransitionLog: INSERT INTO order_state_transition_log (tenant_id, order_id, action, from_fulfillment_status, to_fulfillment_status, to_collection_status, to_fulfillment_mode, source, occurred_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'migrate', NULL, ?, ?, ?, 'MIGRATION', ?)
countMigrationOpening: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_financial_record WHERE order_id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND record_type = 'MIGRATION_OPENING' AND deleted = 0
sumLegacy: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) FROM sale_order WHERE tenant_id = ? AND deleted = 0
sumNew: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), COALESCE(SUM(gross_received_amount), 0) FROM sale_order WHERE tenant_id = ? AND deleted = 0
